extraction.name: EuroSAT
extraction.description: A novel dataset for land use and land cover classification based on Sentinel-2 satellite images covering 13 spectral bands and consisting of 10 classes with 27,000 labeled and geo-referenced images.
extraction.creator: Patrick Helber, Benjamin Bischke, Andreas Dengel, Damian Borth
extraction.publisher: German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence (DFKI)
extraction.citeAs: Helber, P., Bischke, B., Dengel, A., & Borth, D. (2019). EuroSAT: A Novel Dataset and Deep Learning Benchmark for Land Use and Land Cover Classification.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Satellite images were acquired from the Sentinel-2A satellite via Amazon S3, selected based on European Urban Atlas cities with low cloud levels. Images were recorded across Europe throughout the year to capture seasonal and regional variations. The dataset consists of 27,000 manually checked, geo-referenced image patches (64x64 pixels) labeled into 10 land use and land cover classes.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Physical data collection, Web API
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Sentinel-2 satellite images provided by the European Space Agency (ESA) under the Copernicus program, accessed via Amazon S3.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: 2015-2017 (Sentinel-2A and Sentinel-2B satellite data collection period)
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Images were manually checked and corrected for mislabeling, snow/ice coverage, and dead pixels. Atmospheric correction was not applied, allowing natural variations including color casts to remain in the dataset.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Manual annotation of 27,000 image patches into 10 land use and land cover classes based on European Urban Atlas mapping guide. Images were geo-referenced and labeled by human curators.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: Manual human curation (no specific platform mentioned)
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Dataset is publicly available at GitHub with versioning implied through the repository. No explicit deprecation policy mentioned.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset enables applications in agriculture, disaster recovery, climate change monitoring, urban development, and environmental monitoring, contributing to sustainable development goals.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Potential biases include geographic concentration in European cities (34 countries) and seasonal sampling limitations. Classes with higher intra-class variance (e.g., forests, industrial buildings) may have higher annotation ambiguity.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Dataset limitations include: 1) Limited to European regions (34 countries), 2) 10-meter spatial resolution may miss fine-grained features, 3) No atmospheric correction applied (color casts present), 4) Manual annotation may introduce human error, 5) Dataset focuses on land use/cover rather than detailed segmentation.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation, and Benchmarking for deep learning models in land use and land cover classification. Use cases include change detection, map updating, and Earth observation applications.
